name: Contemporary Arts Center New Orleans
watch: Founded by a collective of artists. Its own site gives 1976 in places and says it officially began in 1977; it presents visual art and performance.

name: Kunstforum Wien (Bank Austria)
watch: Bank Austria ended its engagement at the end of 2025, as previously announced, and said it would support cultural and social initiatives in place of a museum. The house reported about 230,000 visitors a year and about 20 permanent staff.

name: Museo Dolores Olmedo
watch: Museum in the La Noria hacienda in Xochimilco, opened in 1994 by the collector Dolores Olmedo, with more than 140 Rivera and 25 Kahlo works. Closed in 2020, it faced an open letter and a protest in July 2025 over changes made in 2020 to the trust and a planned move of the collection (The Art Newspaper, 16 July 2025).

name: The Contemporary Jewish Museum
watch: Founded in 1984; Daniel Libeskind building opened 2008. It closed to the public in December 2024 for at least a year, cut staff, and announced on 18 March 2026 that it would sell the building.

name: Townhouse Gallery
watch: Founded in 1998 as Egypt's first independent contemporary art space. It closed after a state raid in 2015, then ran from a converted factory.
